headline: Frequent Rework of Tokenization Logic
diagnosis: The file 'tokenize.py' is undergoing frequent rework due to ongoing changes in tokenization rules and support for new Python features. Commit messages indicate a recurring theme of fixing bugs related to f-strings and enhancing compatibility with recent PEPs, which suggests instability in the tokenization logic.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the recent commits focusing on f-string handling and PEP compliance to identify common issues.
Create a comprehensive test suite that covers all edge cases related to tokenization, especially for f-strings and new PEPs.
Refactor the tokenization logic to isolate and modularize the handling of different token types, reducing interdependencies.
Establish a clear ownership of the tokenization logic to ensure accountability and reduce the bus factor, potentially assigning a single engineer to maintain this part of the code.
owner_hint: Assign a dedicated engineer to oversee the tokenization logic.
